label: Asset Wall
description: Finished marketing work moving through the frame in 3D, the way the Moda launch film shows it. The work is real images: either the house sample work (generated deck slides, landing pages, social posts, emails and event cards for made-up brands: Flowpath, Oliva Terra, Lumen AI, Studio Bloom, Volt Run, Nimbus, Maré, Bonsai) or the film's own pieces passed as items. Six layouts. 'rolodex': one deck flipping past card by card; the front slide faces the camera, the next ones lean back above it, the ones gone fold away below, out of focus. Use it for 'it builds the whole deck'. 'fly': pieces fly at the camera out of the deep at angles, sharpen and rush past. Use it for 'decks, emails, posts, pages and more'. 'wall': a wall of work in space, the plane turned in 3D, near and far cards out of focus, the camera pushing in, with an open centre for a headline ('1,000 brands for FREE'). 'orbit': pieces float in the side columns round a speaker, clear of the face (ground none). 'fan': a stack fanning open. 'grid': the same piece for many brands flipping in edge-on in a wave ('50 personalised decks'). Full frame. tone 'grey' drains the colour, for the 'AI slop' contrast.

layout.label: wall (default) | rolodex | fly | orbit | fan | grid

items.label: The film's own pieces in place of the house sample work: image URLs, or {src, ratio (height / width)}. Rolodex plays them in order.

headline.label: Big line over the wall, the fly-through or the grid (e.g. '1,000 brands for FREE')

kinds.label: House work by kind: slide | landing | social | email | event (default all; rolodex default slide, grid slide and landing)

brands.label: House work by brand: flowpath | oliva | lumen | bloom | volt | nimbus | mare | bonsai (default all; rolodex default flowpath, the six-slide deck)

count.label: How many pieces: rolodex 3-12 (default 6), fly 4-48 (default 24), orbit 2-10 (default 6 wide, 4 tall), fan 3-7 (default 5), grid 4-16 (default 9, 8 tall). The wall fills the frame.

travel.label: Fly: seconds a piece takes from the deep to past the camera (default 3.2)

colors.label: The ground gradient [from, to, glow?] (default magenta to red: ['#ff2d87', '#ff4a1c'])

ground.label: 'gradient' (default, except orbit and fan) | 'none' (the scene shows through)

card_size.label: Wall: card size as a share of the frame's short side (default 0.34 wide, 0.44 tall)

speed.label: Wall drift and fly speed multiplier (default 1)

tilt.label: Wall: degrees the plane is turned (default -8)

tone.label: 'color' (default) | 'grey': the colour drained and the light down on a dark ground -- generic 'AI slop', the contrast to your own work
